recordedProductIssues: Review overlay text boxes ragged and doubled in places
Cursor sits over the StreamFlix logo and clips it

defects.problem: Cursor covers the 'StreamFlix' wordmark in the top-left while the caption says 'It misses things', pulling the eye to the wrong place.
defects.fix: Trim or hold the cursor path so it starts at the first missed field, not on the logo.

defects.problem: A vertical wipe line is visible across the screen in one sampled frame at the redaction-to-final transition.
defects.fix: Replace with a clean dissolve or clear the line before the cut.

defects.problem: Right-column checklist grows item by item, so the 'Found by the browser' label sits alone for long, and 'Missed, hidden by hand' jumps in mid-column.
defects.fix: Fix the column heights so rows appear in place without the block reflowing.

defects.problem: Caption sub-line empty for 'It misses things' while the headline holds, a dead beat.

oneLineVerdict: Clear story and honest about misses, but a stray wipe line and cursor on the logo cost polish.
